media.alt: Man Cafe reel on coffee bar and Italian recipes
Man Cafe post on coffee and smoothie bar

description: A favorite Punak hangout in Jam Jam Tower: Italian chef (ex-Dutch embassy) recipes, a proper coffee and smoothie bar, board games and live music across indoor, outdoor and VIP spaces. Young crowd, lively evenings. Less a quiet specialty bar than a date-and-hangout spot.
